retainedFailedDiagnostics.disposition: Retained failed cross-runtime assumption. Replaced by exact full-result comparison to a frozen released solver in the same runtime, and exact worker-versus-direct transport comparison in the same runtime. No numerical error allowance, model change, or relaxation of native-reference and convergence criteria.

comparison.interpretation: 3 hosts lost all somatic spikes when modeled host–graft conductance was removed. This supports synaptic dependence for those cells under these exact settings.

summary.transitionInterpretation: A matched intact, synapses-off and zero-stimulus comparison.

limitations: A deterministic synthetic network is sampled. Recruited-cell counts are not biological activation probabilities.
Synapses-off comparisons remove only assigned host–graft conductance. They do not simulate pharmacology, tissue injury, cell death or inflammation.

Activity lost after conductance removal supports dependence within this mathematical model. Persistent activity can include direct electrical activation; a temporal sequence alone is not causal proof.
Source components are exact bookkeeping of the assumed linear forward model. An experimental electrode does not separately measure graft and host currents.
Adjacent sampled response changes are brackets between calculated cases, not fitted thresholds. Untested values, nonmonotone responses and different geometries can change the result.
Conductivity sweeps recalculate stimulation and membrane currents as well as recording transfer. They are not fixed-current inverse-conductivity tests.
The canonical Hodgkin–Huxley benchmark and synthetic morphology remain uncalibrated to mammalian grafts or implanted devices.
Charge density uses the nominal disk geometric area. It does not model electrode impedance, polarization, electrochemistry or an electrochemical safety limit.

responseBoundaryRefinement.definition: At the fixed signed-current endpoints -12 and -18 µA, retain zero and three recruited host somata, respectively, at dt 0.005 and 0.0025 ms. All other settings, including geometry, duration and saved-time grid, remain identical. Each host soma spike count must also agree.
responseBoundaryRefinement.timingInterpretation: Event-index-matched fine-minus-coarse time differences are reported without a separate timing acceptance threshold. These two endpoint checks neither estimate an exact stimulation threshold nor establish uniform convergence throughout the interval.

storagePrecision.method: Independent axial-flux reconstruction from stored Float32 Vm; projection from total membrane-current sources is Float64.
storagePrecision.analyticalBound: For each contact and population, B = L_source A_axial. Bound = sum_j abs(B_j) * halfULP(Float32 Vm_j) + 1e-8 µV. Junction lead rows are zero.
storagePrecision.interpretation: The failed fixed absolute reconstruction diagnostic is retained. The analytical storage-precision consistency bound is a separate check; it does not turn that failure into a pass. Quantitative source exports use the original Float64 waveforms.

comparison.criterion: Exact same-runtime equality with the frozen released implementation; no numerical error allowance.

timing.scope: Node execution wall time for actual calculations, excluding UI rendering and network; not a device-independent performance guarantee.
